name: muse
description: Run Muse lanes (headless muse exec, chained briefs, acceptance) under a supervisor that survives outages and stalls; one panel, one wake-up per finished lane.

envFile.title: Env file with META_API_KEY
envFile.description: Optional. A dotenv file whose values (e.g. META_API_KEY) are passed to muse exec; its values are redacted from every lane file and never logged.
